OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber Could Debut At DevDay

OpenAI is preparing to unveil GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity-focused AI model, potentially at its DevDay event in San Francisco on Sept. 29, Fortune reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the plans.
The company is also expected to introduce a new product designed to help customers deploy the model more securely and automate cybersecurity workflows, including vulnerability detection and patching.
OpenAI did not immediately respond to Benzinga’s request for comment.
GPT-6 Cyber would be OpenAI’s fourth cybersecurity-focused model this year. A limited group of customers already has access through the application-only Daybreak Red program for alpha testing.
